title: Edit Table Columns
description: As a database designer, I want to add, edit, and remove columns on a table so that I can define the schema structure accurately.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a table exists on the diagram, when the user edits a column (name, data type, nullable, default, etc.), then the table reflects the updated column definition

evidence: Column editing functionality fully implemented in src/components/TableNode.tsx: inline edit of column name (double-click), data type dropdown (integer/varchar/text/boolean/date/timestamp/decimal), nullable checkbox, default value text input, add column (+ Add column button), remove column (Remove button)
State management via src/hooks/useDiagram.ts updateTable() propagates column changes to diagram state
App wiring in src/App.tsx: onTableUpdate → updateTable, DiagramCanvas passes onTableUpdate to TableNode

Unit tests: 119 tests passed across 15 files (vitest, node:20-alpine, docker run) — including TableNode.test.tsx column edit/add/remove tests (11 tests), useDiagram.test.ts updateTable with columns test, App.test.tsx add columns test

ESLint: 0 errors for codebase (1 pre-existing warning in App.tsx line 39 unrelated to this ticket)
